text: ✓ #262. The cause: the camera's transform sat on the lines' <svg> too, and a transform on an SVG root re-lays-out and repaints the whole board every pan frame. Now one wrapper moves, lifted onto its own layer while panning: a pan moves tiles already drawn. The page shrank 465 → 131 KB, mostly zod's unused locales.
